title: Read mainline, state, contracts, and tests for a9quant-strategy
goal: Read main_controller.py, account_state.py, contracts.py, and selected tests in /root/a9quant-strategy to confirm the real mainline, state ledger, contract layer, and verification surface before any phase-2 owner-doc writing.
scope: Do not run phase-2 and do not write files in the target project

acceptance.text: Evidence summary captures the actual entrypoint

key_updates: main_controller.py confirms the real runtime mainline already exists: exchange adapter, synchronizer, account state, centralized risk manager, market hub, OMS, ws bridge, and dual engines are wired together under one async controller.
account_state.py and contracts.py confirm there is already a concrete typed state ledger and contract boundary between data sync, risk, strategy, and execution layers.

test_integration.py and test_regression.py confirm the project already tests live-trading gating, trace propagation, synchronizer-only state updates, OMS idempotency, ws reconnect calibration, replay-driven full-chain execution, and the rule that intents must pass risk gating.
decisions: Phase-2 owner-doc reverse-writing can now describe a controller-centered implemented system instead of only a module collection.

Before phase-2 writing, one remaining evidence pass should still verify config and data_synchronizer details, but the mainline, state model, contract boundary, and test surface are already clear enough to anchor owner-doc structure.
risks: data_synchronizer.py and config.json are still not fully audited in this pass, so some runtime dependency and environment assumptions may still be under-described.
The test suite is meaningful, but current evidence is still based on static reads rather than actually running the target project's tests.
verification: Read main_controller.py and confirmed async main loop, policy evaluation, signal processing, OMS submission, reconciliations, and shutdown path.
Read account_state.py and confirmed state ledger updates are derived from DataSynchronizer snapshots and split into risk snapshots and strategy snapshots.
Read contracts.py and confirmed the project already uses typed dataclass contracts for risk, intent, market, snapshot, and account objects.

Read test_integration.py and test_regression.py and confirmed coverage for live gate, trace propagation, synchronizer-only state updates, OMS idempotency, reconnect calibration, replay-driven chain execution, and risk-gate enforcement.
next_steps: Do one last evidence pass on data_synchronizer.py and config.json before phase-2 owner-doc writing.
Keep /root/a9quant-strategy in init-project phase-1 mode until that final dependency/config evidence is added.

conflict_policy.escalation_rule: if conflict remains, escalate to run-main
